The '''Glayyd stronghold''' was a [[Mountain/Legends|mountainside]] fortress located on the [[Kumasi system]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ammuud/Legends|Ammuud]]. The structure had multiple levels and belonged to the [[House Glayyd|Glayyd Clan]], one of Ammuud's seven major clans.<ref name="TEGtPaM" />
